name: eBay
scope: eBay.com sellers without a Store subscription. Store subscribers, eBay Motors vehicles, and eBay Live have different fees and are out of scope.

heavy_equipment.label: Heavy Equipment, Commercial Printing Presses, Food Trucks

structure: One insertion fee per listing after the 250 free listings each month ($0.35; some categories differ). One final value fee when the item sells: a percentage of the total amount of the sale (item price + handling + shipping collected + sales tax + other applicable fees), calculated per item with tiers for most categories (13.6% up to $7,500 and 2.35% on the portion above), plus a per-order fee of $0.30 for orders of $10.00 or less and $0.40 for orders over $10.00. An international fee of 1.65% of the total sale applies when the buyer's delivery or registered address is outside the US and eBay International Shipping is not used. Sellers evaluated Below Standard pay an additional 6% (7% after four consecutive months); a Very High rate of 'item not as described' returns adds 5% (6%) in the affected categories — if both apply only the Below Standard fee is charged. Optional listing upgrades (bold, subtitle, gallery plus, reserve) are charged per listing.

examples.description: Auction-style listing example on the fees page: used smartphone, start $199, Buy It Now $400, free shipping, allowance used, meets performance expectations; sells at $400; total sale $424 with 6% sales tax.
examples.quote: Final value fee (13.6% of $424, + $0.40) $58.06 … Total fees $58.41 … You make $341.59, or approximately 85% of the sale price, not including shipping costs.

examples.quote: Final value fee (13.25% of $7,500, + 2.35% of $2,570, + $0.40) $1,054.55 … Bold fee $4.00 … Total fees $1,058.90 … You make $8,441.10, or approximately 89% of the sale price

quotes: This fee is calculated as a percentage of the total amount of the sale, plus a per order fee. For orders $10.00 or less the per order fee is $0.30, for orders over $10.00 the per order fee is $0.40.
The total amount of the sale includes the item price, any handling charges, any shipping costs collected from the buyer (some exceptions apply), sales tax, and any other applicable fees.
Most categories … First 250 listings free per month, then $0.35 per listing … 13.6% on total amount of the sale up to $7,500 calculated per item … 2.35% on the portion of the sale over $7,500
This fee is calculated as 1.65% of the total amount of the sale and is automatically deducted from your sales.
If your account is evaluated as Below Standard … you'll be charged an additional 6% on the final value fees applicable to sales in the following calendar month.
excluded: Store subscription fees and Store FVF rates
Classified Ad and Real Estate fees
notes: The page's worked examples apply the 6% sales tax to the item price with free shipping; this calculator applies the entered tax rate to price plus shipping, which matches eBay's 'total amount of the sale' definition.

Tiered categories apply the lower rate only to the portion above the threshold; 'whole' categories (bullion, handbags, jewelry, athletic shoes) apply a single rate to the entire amount depending on which side of the threshold the total sale falls.

inputs.label: Buyer's sales tax rate
inputs.help: eBay collects it and includes it in the fee base; you don't keep it.

summary: eBay charges most sellers one final value fee of 13.6% of the total sale (item, shipping, and the buyer's sales tax) plus $0.30 or $0.40 per order, with lower rates above $7,500 and different rates in a dozen categories, plus $0.35 per listing once your 250 free monthly listings are used.
